svg.title: Recognition
svg.desc: Rajasthan Rank 1 (VBYLD 2026); NASA SPACE APPS 2025 Global Finalist Nominee · exoplanet detection; IETE Engineers' Day 2026 1st: Student project competition, with Krishyak; IETE Student's Day 2025 1st: Design competition, IETE Bhawan, Jaipur; Product Hunt #11: LLMSlim on its launch day; HackLoop 2025 Top 10: Finalist from 1,600+ entrants, at Thoughtworks; Polaris Fellowship 2026 Final: Final round, top 100 applicants; BIT Jaipur internal round SIH '26: Nominated for the next round, Krishyak

g.text: National finalist at the Viksit Bharat Young Leaders Dialogue. I presented Krishyak to the
Union Agriculture Minister and the DG of ICAR, and was later invited to the Chief
Minister's Residence, where the CM cited my idea by name.
Nominated for the next round, Krishyak
